subject: Re: Encord Accelerate
text:
Hey Alex & Shivant,

Sorry for this delay on our end.

Landmark placements:

Stream<https://aiatella-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/p/jack/EVRNVoSuvN1Au2ozs3xmHtEBQen9pCD24hZjGFf5gL2z1w?e=jdvPc5&referrer=Outlook.Desktop&referrerScenario=email-linkwithembed>

Segmentation with SAM and Tracking:

Meeting with Jack Parker<https://aiatella-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/p/jack/EXny1VhLDv1Hl2sj4R1wregBIH6Rcrm5KSjn_iL0NSYjsQ?e=vWz0sP&referrer=Outlook.Desktop&referrerScenario=email-linkwithembed>

Attached is the videos going quickly through the labeling procedure for landmark and segmentation.

Some notes:

The landmark video explains the principles and the wanted placements of the points, now it does not go through everypoint since they are in the pdf, but we can make a video with all of them if that would be helpful too.

Regarding the segmentations:
In the segmentation video there's multiple instances of the same class created, usually 1-2 instances should be enough, main situation where 2 separate ones is needed when you see the aorta as the two islands, and you want to use tracking for faster labelling.
I personally would recommend labeling more slices accurately using SAM (depending on the volume), then running the tracking after they are done. This gives me near perfect segmentations in just a few minutes.
Additionally we'll be adding an agent-step to the actual production process as well to speed up segmentation placements.

Overall these videos should clear up our process, but as mentioned we can do one with the full placements in one video too if you think this would be helpful. For the chest scan the whole process is around 10-15min for us, and around 15-20min for a full body scan.

Let me know if you can see the videos and if you'd need anything else!

Best,
Onni

subject: Re: Encord Accelerate
text:
Hi Alex,

Perfect looking forward to it!

Regarding estimations,

We have at the moment:

1200 Chest CT:s that have aortas already labelled, but they need to be checked/finetuned and the landmarks would need to be placed. (shouldn't take much more than 10 min for these cases)

After this we have around 75000 CT:s(mainly chest) that we'll run our agents on first, but same thing there, finetuning/relabeling of the aorta, review and landmarks. Prob between 5-20min depending on the quality of our initial segmentation(should be pretty good by this point)

Then we have some other datasets as well between 2000-6000 images, of abdominal, chest and fullbody CT:s to be labelled, same thing as above. Overall as well the labeling of these projects makes sense to be split ( for example, 200 labelled initially, model trained, agent goes through rest, reviewing the rest)

In addition to these CT:s we also have a LOT of Ultrasound imaging that would need to be labelled, mainly of the carotid arteries. At the moment we have over 50 000 images there with no existing labels and expecting a lot more. These would only need to be labelled after most of the CT:s are done though.

Happy to discuss these things more in the call!

Thank you!

Best,
Onni
